theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiBFM_exists_open_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Rn N), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i)) ∧ (∀ i, μ (W i) < ∞) ∧ ⋃ i, W i = U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
